item.title: Morocco Greenlights Land for New High-Speed Rail Line to Marrakech
item.description: This week’s Official Gazette: land cleared for the Kénitra–Marrakech high-speed line, a nationwide university expansion, new refurbished-medical-device rules, and 25,000+ hectares of tribal land formally recognized.

item.title: Morocco Seizes Olive Groves for the Bouaouan Dam
item.description: Land for the Bouaouan dam is expropriated, three foreign degrees get a path to Moroccan recognition, eight health institutes get fixed capacities, and the Left Alliance gets its ballot symbol for the 23 September 2026 election.
